features.name: Paged habit grid
features.description: Home screen shows habits as large circular icon buttons in a 2x3 grid per page, with swipeable pages (dot indicator) for up to 24 habits. Each circle has a progress ring, current streak number inside, and title below.
features.reason: This is the app's central interaction and identity.

features.name: Tap-and-hold to complete
features.description: Pressing and holding a habit fills the ring and marks it done for today. The circle turns solid white when complete. A hold or menu can undo a completion.
features.reason: A deliberate hold prevents accidental check-offs and is the main daily action.

features.name: Streak counting
features.description: Count consecutive scheduled periods in which the habit was completed. Days the habit is not scheduled are skipped and do not break the streak. Show current and best streak.
features.reason: Building streaks is the stated purpose of the app.

features.name: Multiple completions per day
features.description: A habit can require N completions per day, for example brushing teeth 3 times. The ring is split into N segments and each hold fills one segment. The habit is done when all segments are filled.
features.reason: Shown on the home screen. Common for repeated daily habits.

features.name: Negative habits
features.description: A habit to avoid, such as not smoking. It counts as successful by default for the day. The user records a slip, which breaks the streak. It is marked with a 'no' symbol before the title.
features.reason: The listing promotes breaking bad habits, and it is one of the add-task categories.

features.name: Timed habits
features.description: A habit with a duration, for example 3:00. A play button starts a countdown timer, and the habit completes automatically when the timer ends. The timer can be paused or cancelled.
features.reason: Shown on the home screen and as a category in the add flow. Works fully offline.

features.name: Flexible scheduling
features.description: Choose every day, specific weekdays, or N times per week or month. You can also mark a habit as a one-day task. Unscheduled days do not affect the streak.
features.reason: A days selector appears in the task configuration screen.

features.name: Icon picker
features.description: Choose from hundreds of icons, which can be built on SF Symbols, organised by category with search. Titles are limited to 20 characters, and an automatic title is generated from the template.
features.reason: Every habit is identified by its icon. The listing highlights hundreds of icons.

features.name: Task templates and categories
features.description: The add screen has tabs for general check tasks, health tasks, eating tasks, timed tasks and negative tasks. Each tab offers preset templates plus a custom option, with search.
features.reason: This is how habits are created quickly.

features.name: Reminder notifications
features.description: For each habit, choose no reminder, automatic times or custom times. Options include a time-sensitive toggle, a choice of sound, and an optional notification when the habit is completed. All are scheduled as local notifications.
features.reason: Shown in the screenshots. Works with local notifications only and needs no server.

features.name: Statistics dashboard
features.description: For all habits or one habit, show best streak, completion rate since start, and total completions. Charts include completion rate over time with a date range, completions by weekday, and completions by time of day. The range can be switched, for example from the beginning.
features.reason: The listing highlights viewing statistics, and a screenshot shows the full stats screen.

features.name: Daily notes per habit
features.description: Write a free-text note for any day of a habit. Navigate between days with arrows or a calendar picker.
features.reason: Shown in a screenshot. Simple to build locally.

features.name: Apple Health linked habits
features.description: Habits that complete automatically from HealthKit data, all read on the device: steps, walking or running distance, heart rate zone minutes, stand minutes, cycling, swimming, time in daylight, mindful minutes, flights climbed, medications and activity rings. The user sets a goal, such as 5000 steps.
features.reason: Valuable, but adds HealthKit entitlement complexity. It uses only on-device data and no network.

features.name: Home screen widgets
features.description: Widgets show a multi-habit grid, a single habit ring with its streak, a completion-rate line chart, weekday bars, the streak number, or a calendar dot grid. Interactive widgets can complete a habit.
features.reason: Shown in a screenshot. WidgetKit with an App Group is feasible offline.

features.name: App color themes
features.description: Choose the app's background gradient and accent colour from a set of palettes.
features.reason: Listed as a feature. Cosmetic, but cheap to add.

features.name: Share statistics image
features.description: Render the stats view to an image and open the system share sheet.
features.reason: A share button is visible on the stats screen. Works locally through the share sheet.

features.name: Apple Watch app
features.description: A companion app to view habits and complete them from the wrist.
features.reason: Mentioned in the listing, but it is a separate target and can be added later.

features.name: Shared habits
features.description: Share a habit with another person so they can see its progress and statistics, and assign an emoji avatar to the owner.
features.reason: Requires syncing between users through a server or cloud sharing.

features.name: Seasonal themes
features.description: Holiday themes such as Halloween that are delivered through updates.
features.reason: Non-essential content tied to release marketing.

features.name: Cloud sync across devices
features.description: Keep habit data in sync between a user's devices.
features.reason: Needs network or cloud services. Sbu apps keep data on the device.

screens.name: Home grid
screens.purpose: View today's habits and complete them.
elements: 2x3 grid of circular habit buttons with progress rings
Habit title below, with a heart marker for Health habits and a 'no' marker for negative habits
Duration label and play button for timed habits
'Add task' circle in the first empty slot
Page dots for swiping between pages

screens.name: Add task
screens.purpose: Choose a template or create a custom habit.
elements: Category tabs: check, health, eating, timed, negative
Short explanation of the selected category
List of templates, each with an icon, title and chevron

screens.name: Task configuration
screens.purpose: Set up and save a habit.
elements: Large icon preview with a button to change the icon
Info banner, for example to request Health access
Title text field with automatic placeholder and 0/20 counter
Task type row, e.g. one-day task
Goal row, e.g. 5000 steps, times per day or duration

screens.name: Notifications settings
elements: Reminder choice: none, automatic times or custom times

screens.name: Statistics
screens.purpose: Review progress for all habits or a single habit.
elements: Range selector button, e.g. since start
Row of habit icons to filter
Line chart of completion rate with start date, number of days, and today
Page indicator for overall view versus each habit

screens.name: Daily note editor
screens.purpose: Write a note about a habit for a given day.
elements: Date title with previous and next arrows

screens.name: Timer
screens.purpose: Run the countdown for a timed habit.
elements: Large ring filling as time passes
Haptic and sound feedback on finish

screens.name: Settings
elements: Export and import of data as JSON

flows.name: Create a habit
steps: On the home screen, tap the 'Add task' circle.
Pick a category tab or search the templates.
Select a template.
Adjust the title, icon, goal and days.
Optionally set up reminders.
Tap Save. The habit appears in the next free grid slot.

flows.name: Complete a habit
steps: Press and hold the habit circle.
The ring fills during the hold, with a haptic at the end.
The circle turns solid and the streak number increments.
For habits with several completions, each hold fills one segment.

flows.name: Run a timed habit
steps: Tap the play button on the timed habit.
The timer screen counts down.
When it reaches zero, the habit is marked complete and a notification fires if the app is in the background.

flows.name: Record a slip on a negative habit
steps: Press and hold the negative habit.
Confirm the slip.
The day is recorded as failed and the current streak resets.

flows.name: Health auto-complete
steps: Create a Health template habit, such as walking 5000 steps.
Grant HealthKit read permission.
The app queries HealthKit on launch and through background delivery.
When the goal is reached, the habit is marked complete automatically.

flows.name: Review statistics
steps: Tap the star button on the home screen.
See the overall statistics.
Swipe, or tap a habit icon, to see that habit's statistics.
Change the range.
Optionally share the stats as an image.

flows.name: Add a daily note
steps: From the habit's menu, open Note.
Pick a date with the arrows or the calendar.
Type the note.
Tap Done to save.

fields.name: title
fields.note: Maximum 20 characters. Empty means an automatic title.

fields.name: timesPerDay
fields.note: Number of ring segments. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: healthMetric
fields.note: e.g. steps, distance, flights or mindfulMinutes

fields.name: scheduleType
fields.note: everyDay, weekdays, timesPerWeek, timesPerMonth or oneDay

fields.name: timesPerPeriod
fields.note: Used for N times per week or month

fields.name: sortIndex
fields.note: Position in the grid. 24 habits maximum.

fields.name: archived
fields.note: Hides the habit without deleting history

fields.name: dayKey
fields.note: yyyy-MM-dd in local time, adjusted for the rollover setting

fields.name: notifyOnComplete
fields.note: Local notification when the habit is completed

fields.name: dayKey
fields.note: One note per habit per day

data_model.storage: SwiftData stored locally in an App Group container so widgets can read it. No network access and no cloud sync. Optional JSON export and import through the share sheet and the Files app.

monetization.notes: The Sbu version is completely free, with no account, ads, in-app purchases or tracking. The original costs a one-time 6.99 €.
